name: Four Decoupled Architectural Axes
formal_statement: An entity's architectural state is modeled across four mutually independent axes: Canonical Identity, Semantic Ownership, Physical Location, and Family Membership. Mutating one axis (e.g. disk relocation or family reclassification) must not alter another.
verification_notes: Verified passing in test_semantic_object_model.py and test_physical_ownership.py.

name: Ten First-Class Object Roles
formal_statement: The catalog recognizes exactly 10 first-class object types: Capability, Workflow, Primitive, Overlay, Adapter, Router, Reference, GeneratedArtifact, Family, and Alias. Analytical statuses like manual_review are tracked via ReviewStatus and are not SkillRoles.
verification_notes: Verified passing; SkillRole enum and normalization logic enforces 10 roles and excludes manual_review.

name: Eight Relationship Edge Types
formal_statement: The catalog object graph connects nodes using exactly 8 typed relationships: COMPOSED_OF, EXTENDS, DEPENDS_ON, ADAPTS, ALIASED_TO, CATEGORIZED_IN, OVERLAID_BY, and RUNTIME_PROJECTED_AS.
verification_notes: Verified passing; RelationshipType enum supports all 8 edge types and handles graph syncing.

name: Provisional Guardrail 4: Depth-Constrained Specialization
formal_statement: Overlay specialization depth is strictly limited to depth 1: an Overlay object cannot extend another Overlay object.
verification_notes: Verified passing; ObjectGraph asserts no overlay-to-overlay EXTENDS relationships.

name: Provisional Guardrail 5: Composition Discipline
formal_statement: Primitive objects cannot compose other objects (cannot declare COMPOSED_OF relationships).
verification_notes: Verified passing; ObjectGraph rejects primitives declaring composition edges.

name: RFC 8141 URN Syntax and Compact String Representation
formal_statement: Every catalog object possesses an immutable canonical identity conforming to RFC 8141 URN syntax 'urn:skill:<scope>:<slug>' and dual compact form '<scope>:<slug>'. Slugs and scopes must match '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]*[a-z0-9]$'.
verification_notes: Verified passing; strict regex validation on scope and slug; dual representation supported.

name: Path-Independence Invariant (INV-6)
formal_statement: Canonical identity is decoupled from physical storage location. Slashes ('/', '\') and file extensions are strictly prohibited in canonical identifiers.
verification_notes: Verified passing; attempts to pass path syntax or file extensions fail-closed.

name: Single Canonical Owner Invariant (INV-2)
formal_statement: A canonical identifier must map to exactly one primary object in the catalog. Duplicate registrations of the same canonical identity must raise InvariantViolationError.
verification_notes: Verified passing; duplicate node registration immediately raises InvariantViolationError.

name: Scope Namespace Separation
formal_statement: Scope acts as an immutable provenance namespace, allowing identical leaf names to coexist across different scopes (e.g. 'github:create-pr' vs 'gitlab:create-pr') without namespace collision.
verification_notes: Verified passing; identity equality checks evaluate both scope and slug.

name: Physical Storage Planes
formal_statement: The physical library layout is strictly partitioned into three physical planes: DOMAIN_TREE (canonical category/subcategory taxonomy), PLATFORM_HUB (tools-and-platforms/<fam>/<comp>/<slug>), and META_INFRASTRUCTURE (meta-and-agent-skills/...).
verification_notes: Verified passing; PhysicalPlane enum and parser cleanly map all 3 physical zones.

name: Physical Path Syntax and Depth Constraints
formal_statement: Physical paths must be normalized POSIX relative paths without leading 'library/', backslashes, or directory traversal '..'. Platform hubs cannot exceed max directory depth of 4.
verification_notes: Verified passing; invalid path characters, traversal, and depth violations fail-closed.

name: Subdirectory Role Segregation
formal_statement: Specialized object types must reside in conforming physical directories: Overlays must reside under 'overlays/', Adapters under 'adapters/', and nested overlay directories are prohibited.
verification_notes: Verified passing; layout validator verifies physical directory naming matches declared role.

name: Direction-Neutral Duplicate Candidate Resolution
formal_statement: Duplicate candidate pairs (such as the 15 GitHub operations duplicate pairs) must be maintained under direction-neutral hypotheses until formal migration adjudication, prohibiting premature deletion or overwriting.
verification_notes: Verified passing; duplicate registry holds all 15 pairs without biased deduplication.

name: Four-Gate Family Qualification Framework
formal_statement: Platform families must satisfy four explicit qualification gates: GATE_1_MIN_SIZE (distinct skill count threshold), GATE_2_COHESION (minimum functional cohesion across multi-domain density), GATE_3_CROSS_DOMAIN (cross-domain capability breadth), and GATE_4_EXECUTION_SURFACE (declared execution provider interfaces).
verification_notes: Verified passing; evaluator assesses all 4 gates against census records with fail-closed rules.

name: Three-Tier Family Classification
formal_statement: Families are classified into three architectural tiers: TIER_1_PLATFORM_HUBS (mature platforms with dedicated physical hub), TIER_2_LOGICAL_CROSS_CUTTING (cross-domain logical groupings remaining in domain tree), and TIER_3_PROVISIONAL (nascent clusters).
verification_notes: Verified passing; tier assignments dictate physical placement vs logical tagging.

name: Execution Provider Decoupling and Pure Protocol Adapters
formal_statement: Execution providers (CLI, MCP, API, SDK, NATIVE) are decoupled from core skill capabilities. Adapter objects function as pure protocol shims and must not mutate skill behavioral definitions.
verification_notes: Verified passing; multi-provider bindings supported without modifying base capability.

name: Authoritative Compiled Catalog Registry Schema
formal_statement: The compiled catalog registry (audit/skills-registry.json) is the authoritative, deterministic representation of catalog state, containing identity, semantic ownership, physical path, family membership, dependencies, and execution providers.
verification_notes: Verified passing; serialization conforms to standard schema; deterministic compilation verified.

name: Four Universal Projection Views and Inverted Search Index
formal_statement: The registry compiler generates four deterministic read projection views (Functional, Family, Semantic Group, Provider) and an inverted keyword search index from authoritative registry data.
verification_notes: Verified passing; MultiViewProjector generates all 4 projection views and inverted search index.

name: Single-Hop Alias Resolution Invariant (INV-3)
formal_statement: Alias pointers must resolve directly to target canonical objects in a single hop. Chained aliases (A -> B -> C) and circular alias loops are strictly prohibited and must fail validation.
verification_notes: Verified passing; AliasResolver and ObjectGraph strictly reject multi-hop and circular aliases.

name: DAG Acyclicity and Transitive Completeness (INV-1, INV-9)
formal_statement: Composition and dependency graphs must form a strict Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with zero circular dependencies (INV-1). Materializing a skill for execution must automatically bundle all transitive dependencies (INV-9).
verification_notes: Verified passing; topological sort and cycle detection enforces acyclicity; transitive bundling verified.

name: Flat Runtime Collision Resolution and Candidate Ladder
formal_statement: When materializing skills into flat runtime symlink targets (~/.agents/skills/), leaf name collisions must be resolved deterministically using a scoped prefix ladder without overwriting or race conditions.
verification_notes: Verified passing; deterministic collision-free candidate ladder generates unique flat slugs.

name: Gate 1: Canonical Identity Validation
formal_statement: Validates RFC 8141 URN compliance, scope namespace isolation, path-independence (zero slashes or extensions), and verifies single canonical ownership across the catalog.
verification_notes: Verified passing; evaluates identity validity and uniqueness with fail-closed violations.

name: Gate 2: Physical Layout and Ownership Validation
formal_statement: Validates storage plane partitioning, normalized POSIX relative paths, max depth bounds, adapter/overlay directory placement, and direction-neutral duplicate pair registration.
verification_notes: Verified passing; layout rules enforced across all 3 physical planes.

name: Gate 3: Family Qualification and Provider Decoupling
formal_statement: Validates that all declared platform families pass the 4 qualification gates and execution provider bindings decouple correctly from capabilities.
verification_notes: Verified passing; ensures families satisfy threshold criteria before catalog adoption.

name: Gate 4: Source Asset and Manifest Authenticity (INV-8, INV-10)
formal_statement: Guarantees 100% byte-for-byte asset preservation via SHA-256 manifest comparisons (INV-8), verifies zero truncation of SKILL.md or auxiliary assets, and validates strict staging directory containment (INV-10).
verification_notes: Verified passing across 27 exhaustive positive and negative test cases.

name: Gate 5: Reference Closure and DAG Integrity
formal_statement: Verifies that all dependency, composition, extension, and alias references resolve to valid existing objects in the catalog with zero dangling references (INV-7) and zero circular cycles (INV-1).
verification_notes: Verified passing; graph traversal checks complete reference closure.

name: Gate 6: Generated Views and Navigation Routers
formal_statement: Validates that all four projection views, the search index, and physical router tree Markdown files are completely and correctly generated from authoritative registry data.
verification_notes: Verified passing; validates presence and structure of all projection views.

name: Gate 7: Deterministic Compilation
formal_statement: Guarantees deterministic compilation: two successive compilations of the catalog from identical inputs must produce byte-equal registry and view artifacts.
verification_notes: Verified passing; validates cryptographic byte-equality across successive compilations.

name: Gate 8: Project Materialization Pre-Flight
formal_statement: Pre-flight validation verifying that project materialization builds collision-free flat runtime symlink targets and guarantees transitive prerequisite bundling.
verification_notes: Verified passing; verifies materialization staging without modifying runtime directory.

name: Gate 9: Runtime Publication Pre-Flight
formal_statement: Final migration pre-flight verifying git working tree cleanliness, remote tracking status, and runtime destination authorization before cutover.
verification_notes: Verified passing in migration gate test suite; end-to-end runner verified.

name: INV-1: Graph Acyclicity
formal_statement: Composition and dependency graphs must form a strict Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with zero circular dependencies.
verification_notes: Verified passing; cycle detection prevents circular graph edges.

name: INV-2: Single Canonical Owner
formal_statement: Each canonical ID maps to exactly one primary object in the catalog. Duplicate primary ownership is prohibited.
verification_notes: Verified passing; registration dictionary enforces 1:1 primary node uniqueness.

name: INV-3: Single-Hop Alias Purity
formal_statement: Alias pointers must resolve directly to target canonical objects in exactly 1 hop. Chained and circular aliases are prohibited.
verification_notes: Verified passing; multi-hop alias lookups raise InvariantViolationError.

name: INV-4: Physical Plane Separation
formal_statement: Physical skill packages must reside in exactly one authorized physical plane (Domain Tree, Platform Hub, Meta-Infrastructure) conforming to path depth and naming syntax.
verification_notes: Verified passing; paths failing plane structural rules are rejected.

name: INV-5: Census-Grounded Family Eligibility
formal_statement: Family membership claims must be grounded in verified census records; candidates asserting fabricated paths or unverified memberships are rejected.
verification_notes: Verified passing; 14 positive and negative tests assert strict census grounding.

name: INV-6: Path Independence
formal_statement: Canonical IDs cannot encode or embed physical directory structures, slashes, or file extensions. Physical moves do not mutate canonical IDs.
verification_notes: Verified passing; canonical identity survives physical relocations unchanged.

name: INV-7: Reference Closure
formal_statement: All outward relationships (extends, composed_of, depends_on, adapts, aliased_to) must target valid, registered canonical IDs.
verification_notes: Verified passing; dangling targets trigger Gate 5 failure.

name: INV-8: Asset Integrity Preservation
formal_statement: Physical migration of skill packages must maintain 100% byte-for-byte SHA-256 fidelity across all files; zero truncation or loss of auxiliary files.
verification_notes: Verified passing; manifest hashing catches single-byte differences.

name: INV-9: Transitive Runtime Completeness
formal_statement: Runtime project materialization of a capability automatically bundles all required transitive dependencies into the materialization manifest.
verification_notes: Verified passing; materialization graph walking bundles transitive prerequisites.

name: INV-10: Path Containment Safety
formal_statement: All file operations, symlink creation, and staging targets must resolve strictly within authorized repository and staging roots; path traversal ('..') and escaping symlinks fail-closed.
verification_notes: Verified passing; robust canonical path resolution prevents escaping boundary.

name: Append-Only Audit Change Ledger
formal_statement: All state changes to the catalog, lifecycle actions, or migrations must record structured entries in audit/change-ledger.jsonl with timestamp, action, target, and commit hash.
verification_notes: Verified passing in scenario testing; JSON Lines appended atomically.

name: Shared Path and Environment Configuration Contract
formal_statement: Shared path constants (LIBRARY_DIR, INTAKE_DIR, RUNTIME_DIR, AUDIT_DIR, LEDGER_FILE, MANIFEST_FILE) and 10 canonical categories are centrally declared in config.py and consumed across all tools.
verification_notes: Verified passing; configuration supports runtime injection and hermetic test isolation.

name: Destructive Command and Secret Protection Patterns
formal_statement: Centralized regex filters intercept destructive shell commands, provider coupling patterns, secret leakage, and absolute workstation paths prior to commit or publication.
verification_notes: Verified passing; used by validator, scanner, and sync tools.

name: Six-Phase Gated Migration Ordering
formal_statement: The catalog migration proceeds through six strictly ordered phases: Phase 01 (Foundation), Phase 02 (Census & Qualification), Phase 03 (Adjudication), Phase 04 (Physical Migration), Phase 05 (Registry & Views), and Phase 06 (Runtime Distribution). Live cutover is deferred until after Gate 9 passes.
verification_notes: Verified passing; phase dependencies and prerequisite gates enforced in migration tests.

name: Decoupled Runtime Distribution and Multi-Destination Authorization
formal_statement: Runtime distribution is decoupled from library structure, supporting three distinct destination types (Local User Runtime, Workspace Deployment, Remote Publish) requiring dual authorization before dispatch.
verification_notes: Contract definitions and target schema implemented; live remote publication CLI requires authentication mock in automated test harness (SKIL-13 failure register).

name: Historical Audit Evidence Preservation
formal_statement: All original audit evidence from Rebuild Phases 1 through 12 in audit/rebuild-phase-1-12/ and legacy task specs in legacy-rebuild-phase-1-13/ must be preserved untouched.
verification_notes: Verified passing; static regression tests verify non-destruction of historical records.
